# FOSSStudio

> FOSSStudio is a free, open-source, self-hosted video podcast studio
> (AGPL-3.0) by Lightmorphic Ltd. Guests join by link with no account,
> up to ten in a room; a track per person recorded in their own browser
> and handed over exactly as recorded, plus one video of everyone that
> matches what was on screen; a view-only output link that works as an
> OBS browser source; one-paste Docker Compose install. No database, no
> trackers, no external calls, and nothing on the server that opens a
> recording. It records a show and hands you the files: it does not
> publish a podcast, does not broadcast, does not edit, and has no
> screen sharing.

Version 0.1.0, a public beta. It is not ready to be relied on: data loss
and breaking changes are possible, and nobody should put a show they
cannot record again on it yet. Releases are marked as pre-release on
GitHub.

- Home: https://fossstudio.org/
- Source and README: https://github.com/lightmorphic/fossstudio
- Sister project (podcast hosting and RSS): https://fosscast.org/
- License: AGPL-3.0 - https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.html
- Hosted, for people who would rather not run a server:
  https://castmorphic.com
- Contact: complaints@lightmorphic.com
